data.name: Manjit
data.gender_notes: Manjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Manjit is derived from Sanskrit words ‘manas’ (mind) and ‘jit’ (victorious). The name signifies someone who has conquered their mind, a symbol of wisdom and self-control. The name Manjit carries the meaning “Gem” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manjit usually hope their child will grow to embody gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the victory of the mind over the senses.
data.etymology: Manjit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manjit total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism and Buddhism, the name Manjit holds spiritual significance as the name of the deityManjughosha, the god of wisdom, knowledge, and enchantment. Manjughosha also symbolizes the conquest of the heart, mind, and senses.The name is believed to bestow wisdom, purity of mind, and the power to overcome worldly desires, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Manjit: Radiant Victory. The name Manjit symbolizes the inner victory of the soul over worldly desires and the attainment of spiritual enlightenment. It is a reminder to continually strive towards self-improvement and triumph over the challenges of life.
